entry.title: Stick Ranger v1.8.1
entry.content:
## Installation
- Download the APworld for Stick Ranger - Put the stick_ranger.apworld in the /custom_worlds folder inside Archipelago - Generate a yaml or download the one in here - Customize the yaml and put it in the /players folder inside Archipelago - Generate a game - Connect to and play the game [here](https://kryen112.github.io/)
## Heads up
- **If you are playing a seed with Shop Checks right now, reload the page and carry on.** You do not need a new seed, a new yaml, or the new APworld. The website has already updated. - Requires Archipelago **0.6.7 or newer**.
## Shop Checks never worked
Shop Checks has been broken since it was added in 1.7.0, for everyone, on every seed. Buying an item never sent its check.
The APworld built all 462 shop locations correctly, which is why they showed up in the tracker and could be released by hand. But it never told the website the option was on, and the website treats an option it was not told about as off. So the shop behaved exactly like vanilla and quietly sent nothing.
Thanks to the player who reported this.
### Your run is not lost
A seed generated before this release still does not say whether Shop Checks is on, so the website now works it out from the seed itself: only Shop Checks creates locations in the shop range. If they are there, the feature is on.
So an in-progress run recovers on its own. Reload the page and buying starts sending checks. **No regeneration.**
If you already released your shop checks by hand, the website now takes the server's word for which ones are done, so those items go back to being ordinary purchases instead of asking to be checked again. You will not pay for something that is already gone.
### Also
- New APworld tests assert that every option the website acts on actually reaches it. That is the check that was missing, and it is what let this ship in the first place.

entry.content:
## Installation
- Download the APworld for Stick Ranger - Put the stick_ranger.apworld in the /custom_worlds folder inside Archipelago - Generate a yaml or download the one in here - Customize the yaml and put it in the /players folder inside Archipelago - Generate a game - Connect to and play the game [here](https://kryen112.github.io/)
## Heads up
- **Nothing to do.** No gameplay change, no option change, no seed change. If you are on 1.8.1 you are already up to date; the website has updated itself. - The APworld is identical to 1.8.1 apart from its version number, so there is no need to re-download it or regenerate anything. - Requires Archipelago **0.6.7 or newer**.
## Changes
### Client
- Removed ten leftover values the website set on connect and then never read. They were the boss class and stage requirements, which the website stopped using in 1.8.0 when it started evaluating the logic the seed ships. Leaving them in made it look like those gates were still wired up by hand, which is exactly the confusion that caused the 1.6.0 logic bugs. - The save is no longer fetched with an argument that was being read as a "watch this key" flag, so the server stops echoing a notification back on every single save.
Both are housekeeping following the 1.8.1 audit. Nothing you can see changed.

entry.title: Laika: Aged Through Blood v0.1.5
entry.content: # V-0.1.5 IS OFFICIALLY RELEASED! Hope everyone is ready for a **MASSIVE** update coming your way! The Wasteland has improved a lot since v-0.1.4, and I have a lot of new and exciting fixes for you guys to try out. So take a seat and share this excitement with me as I give you all the juicy things I have been working on in the background! # Fixes ### Plenty of bug fixes, including newer... and longstanding bugs! Let's do some (late) spring-cleaning! * **Hectist and The Bonehead’s Hook:** Receiving the grappling hook early no longer lets you interact with her stale exterior dialogue. Added recovery for quest progression when you destroy the debris before completing the expected bomb step. * **Hook Head:** Completing The Bonehead’s Hook now recovers the location if early Hook access made its pickup unavailable. * **Harpoon parts:** Turning in AP-provided items `Key Item: Carved Whale Tooth` and `Key Item: Long Rope` now sends their locations, preventing those checks from being lost when vanilla removes the pickups. * **Magical Book:** Receiving the book early no longer leaves its shop location unchecked. The check sends after completing its book dialogue, with recovery for saves where that dialogue already happened. * **Shop cleanup:** Added location recovery for consumed AP key items before removing remaining shop stock. * **Gargantuan Swimcrab:** Corrected its logic to follow the antenna-route requirements instead of requiring Radio Silence completion. Updated the tracker explanation to match. * **Logic Tweaks:** The Wastelanders and `Boss Defeated: A Gargantuan Swimcrab` have had their logic tightened to ensure more runs are possible. More logic tweaks are necessary, but these are the two biggest that have been fixed. # Downtime Adjustment ### Good news (and some) bad news. * Laika no longer begins the run with her pistol. This is due to a potential contribution to how enemies spawn later on the level *Where Birds Lurk* level. Players can receive AP weapons early, but Laika will be required to grab her pistol from Jakob * If a player receives a weapon early enough to avoid the need of acquiring the pistol, the game will distribute the pistol alongside that weapon to ensure Laika still receives the pistol. * The long road sequence after speaking to Orella following the Pope fight is now completely skipped, using the game’s normal return transition. Less time for you to wait for dialogue to pass! * Roy’s lengthy outbound boat ride and dialogue sequence during Radio Silence is now also COMPLETELY SKIPPED! Yes, this includes first meeting him, all the way through getting caught at the last gate. Hopefully this makes up for losing the pistol at the start <3. # Client and UI ### Our older versions had broken or outright messy UI, leading to confusion or messy user display. That, however, has since been fixed! * Fixed incorrect PrintJSON colors for items from other games. * Standardized Laika’s item colors and improved support for Archipelago events, including chat and players joining or leaving. * Updated the “Archipelago Edition” menu text and added a version display in the bottom-left corner. * Updated the advertised Archipelago client version to 0.6.7 and aligned build/deployment dependencies. # Diagnostics ### Mostly backend stuff for me to fix future problems easier. This should provide little impact to gameplay and narrow down issues to squash them sooner. * Added automatic boat and grapple diagnostics without additional hotkeys. * Diagnostic output now uses one `LaikaBoatTrace.log` instead of creating timestamped files. Save reloads preserve the current run’s evidence, and recording has a cap to verify any potential issues/improvements that can be made from our new boat transition scene. # Known issues ### Only one minor bug. However, how long will that last for? * **[Minor]:** Discovered a strange interaction where the player may temporarily lose the `Bike Upgrade: Grappling Hook` during Hectist's bomb sequence. Reloading your save grants the grappling hook back. Attempting to reciprocate this in testing yielded little results (If this happens, please include `LogOutput.log` and `LaikaBoatTrace.log` from the BepInEx folder in your report. Copy them before restarting the game). # Updating ### As always, please read below before immediately attempting to update/replacing files! The AP World and LaikaMod both require updates, as logic has been tweaked and *plenty* of modifications have been done to LaikaMod specifically. As always, you are advised to start new runs when updating due to the sheer amount of tweaks and updates done compared to the previous version. The other files included are not required to update, but are present regardless to provide a seamless onboarding experience for those interested. # Closing Thoughts/Notes That's all for now! You have no idea how happy I am to finally bring this update after all this time. These fixes and tweaks have made me feel confidant to change the `Alpha` tag... to `Beta`! This is a massive deal, and here is to hoping to eventually removing `Beta` and changing `Unstable` to `Stable` very soon! Yes, you read that right... We're out of Alpha, and officially in Beta! I think now is a better time than ever, especially now that our little AP is shaping up to be a proper and more stable AP. I'm excited for what comes next, and hope all of y'all are as well. Stay safe out in the Wasteland, and make sure to make those birds pay! **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ItsSeras/Laika-Aged-Through-Blood-Archipelago/compare/v-0.1.4...v-0.1.5

entry.title: Mega Man Zero 3 v0.3.6
entry.content:
Small update. New yaml options for rank requirements and infinite lives, and the apworld now has an archipelago.json.
[Full Readme here](https://github.com/brodieberger/MMZero3Archipelago) [Link to poptracker pack here](https://github.com/ambibii/mmz3-poptracker/releases/tag/v3.5.1)
## Features
### EX Skill rank (option) `ex_skill_rank` sets the rank you need on a stage clear to get that stage's EX Skill check.
This replaces `easy_ex_skill`, with `ex_skill_rank: f` doing the same thing.
### Final stage rank (option) `final_stage_rank` sets the required rank you need for every stage before the final stage opens. Default is F, which means clearing the final level in any way would unlock the final boss.
It also has a `none` setting that drops the stage clears entirely. The final stage opens as soon as you are holding the required secret disks.
Your best rank on each stage is shown when you hover it on the mission select screen.
### Infinite lives (option) Does what you think it would.

# Changes - Update songs to Slumbering Golden Mark - Updated maximum song count to 800. - HOTFIX: Renamed the new Euphoria song to `Euphoria Laur` to avoid overlap with Euphoria from the Valentine Stage pack

> You can find Muse Dash's folder by finding the game in your steam library, right clicking it and choosing *Manage→Browse Local Files*.
### Windows 1. Download `MelonLoader.Installer.exe` from https://github.com/LavaGang/MelonLoader/releases/latest and run it. 2. Select Muse Dash in the list of games. - If Muse Dash does not appear, click add game manually then browse to `MuseDash.exe`. 3. ### Linux 1. Navigate to Muse Dash on steam, open properties and add the following to Launch Options: `WINEDLLOVERRIDES="version=n,b" %command%` 2. Download `MelonLoader.Installer.Linux` from https://github.com/LavaGang/MelonLoader/releases/latest and run it. - You may need to give it permissions to execute. 3. Select Muse Dash in the list of games. - If Muse Dash does not appear, click add game manually then browse to `MuseDash.exe`. 4. Click install. On first run, melonloader may install dotnet 6 in order to run. - If the latest version is not working: **Untick Latest and select 0.7.2**
### Mod Install 1.Download `ArchipelagoMuseDash.zip`. 2. Head to the Muse Dash folder and open up `/mods/`. If this folder does not exist, run the game and it should appear. 3. Extract the contents of the .zip file into mods. Ensure the files are not in a subfolder, this mod is not setup for that yet. 4. Run the game. If a new button appears on the start screen the mod was installed correctly.

- **Hit Character:** optional checks for hitting each of the sixteen racers, with unlocked racers joining your races. - **Slide Coliseum and Turbo Track:** optional Trophy Races and CTR Challenges on both. - **Cortex Vortex** by Lockheart is the default track for Oxide's Final Challenge, and can optionally show up on a warp pad and in Gem Cups too. - **Adventure tracker:** a hub map with checks per destination, plus RACERS and ITEMS tabs, from Square or TRACKER in the hub pause menu. - **Room links (Windows):** click your slot's link on an Archipelago room page and the game opens and connects. - **AP boxes:** new crate look, colours by item type (can be turned off), and boxes in locked boss races and cup legs show as see-through instead of paying out. - **Options:** menu split into pages, Skip Podium Ceremonies, VSync, Mute When Unfocused, window size remembered. - **Custom tracks:** the Custom Content page now defaults to Baby T Park 1.0.2; seeds made for 1.0.0 still play. - **Logic fixes:** boost requirements, shuffled Gem Cup pads, racer lock spread, stage 2 above stage 1, and the Mystery Caves and Polar Pass boxes you couldn't reach.
## Downloads
Get `ctr-archipelago-v0.2.1-windows-x86.zip` for Windows or `ctr-archipelago-v0.2.1-linux-x86.tar.gz` for Linux and Steam Deck (glibc 2.36 or newer). Each has the client and the matching `ctr.apworld`; use both together with a fresh seed. The separate `ctr.apworld` and `Crash.Team.Racing.yaml` are for hosts and generators. The `.sha256` files check your downloads, and the `.debug` files help with crash reports; you don't need them to play. You need your own NTSC-U disc; no game data is included. The client isn't code-signed.
Known issues: large reconnect backlogs can stall the game ([#147](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/147)), Fullscreen can lag on Steam Deck ([#260](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/260)), and some podium characters can show up invisible ([#282](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/282)). The Linux build got a quick check on the Steam Deck.

## Reporting a problem
[Open a GitHub issue](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/new/choose) with your client version, platform, seed or YAML and what happened. Include the support bundle when it helps: run `support-bundle.bat` on Windows or `support-bundle.sh` on Linux and check it before attaching; it doesn't upload anything by itself. Questions are welcome in the [Crash Team Racing channel](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1222304293751750777) on the Archipelago Discord.

entry.title: Dead Rising Deluxe Remaster v1.1.1
entry.content:
A small apworld fix release so 1.1 can be listed on the Archipelago Index. Nothing changes in game.
## Fixes
- **The apworld now loads in stricter Archipelago builds.** The manifest (`archipelago.json`) declared the apworld container format as version 8, which Archipelago doesn't support. Current releases logged an "invalid manifest" error and loaded it anyway; the Archipelago Index's loader refused it outright, and Archipelago 0.7.0 would too. It's back to 7. - **Generation is deterministic again.** With **Guaranteed Items** set or **Restricted Item Mode** on, the same seed could build a different item pool from one run to the next, because those items were read in an unstable order before the pool was shuffled. They're now read in a fixed order.
## Testing
This build passes the full Archipelago Index test suite: unit tests, the options template check, and all eleven fuzz variants at the index's run counts (5,000 generations for the standard runs, 500 for each check), with no failures.
## Upgrading
- Replace `drdr.apworld` in your Archipelago `custom_worlds` folder. That's the only change that matters. - The mod itself is unchanged apart from its version number. Extracting the new zip over your install is optional, and only updates the version shown in session logs. - Seeds generated with 1.1.0 keep working.

entry.title: Harry Potter 2 PC v2.11.1.post2
entry.content:
# HP2PC_AP v2.11.1 A new open castle option, two Jelly-Legs Jinx fixes, and a boss check fix.
### New - **Always Goyle in Slytherin Common Room** (`always_goyle_in_slytherin_common_room`, open castle only, on by default). Harry wears the Goyle disguise for the whole room, so the Slytherins never chase him. A Polyjuice Potion Trap has no effect there, and the disguise comes off when you leave the level.
### Fixed - **Spongify pads work during the Jelly-Legs Jinx.** Landing on an active pad bounces you as normal. - **Whomping Willow roots knock you back during the Jelly-Legs Jinx.** A root hit throws Harry clear again, instead of pinning him in place and hitting him every frame. - **Killing the Basilisk or Aragog always sends its check.** Holding the cutscene skip button could carry you out of the level before the kill registered, so Chamber of Secrets - Complete (or Forbidden Forest - Complete) never sent. The kill now also counts the moment its victory cutscene starts.

entry.title: Taskipelago v1.2.0rc2
entry.content:
*The big region overhaul (and also clicker game mode)*
## What's new (v1.2.0) * New types of item grouping definitions. Now progressive, aesthetic, or random-choice * aesthetic groups merely group things aesthetically with no effect on progression or not. * random-choice groups randomly choose N or N% as you define items from within the group to be included in the world. No tasks may depend on individual items in these groups since they aren't guaranteed to exist, but depending on the randomized group as a whole or by percentage/count is supported. * progressive groups function the same as always * Regions can now also be randomized to include N or N% of tasks within that region. May optionally also shuffle the order in which such tasks appear. * Subregions can now be defined within regions that aren't randomized (subregions may be randomized). * Regions may now depend on items and tasks via the syntax item(expr) and task(expr) where expr is any valid task or item dependency expression * Tasclickpelago toggle on the yaml generator that enables a bunch of features for building out an idle game because the concept was funny and I thought of a way to do it well. * Style tab added to the YAML generator so you can recolor the entire application at will while connected to the slot in question. Pretty colors are pretty. * Fix browser choice to use user's default where possible and never prefer Edge otherwise
Note: should be fully backwards compatible with worlds generated from 1.0 onwards. Also Universal Tracker is still incompatible.

entry.title: Half-Life (Sven Co-op) v0.1.0
entry.content:
Note that this is a very early build of the apworld. Please report any problems in Discord or the Issues page on github (with reproduction steps please and thank you!)
Sven Co-op's Half-Life campaign is meant to be played in multiplayer. No support will be offered to players attempting to circumvent this restriction. (The map "Suspension" is an exception to this rule)
**Important**: Run /install to update the plugin after you update your apworld.
## New Features * Added the map "suspension" as an option to be enabled in the YAML. This is a co-op class-based arcade shooter where you fight your way across a bridge. Quite fun, and works well for archipelago. * Added new, more refined, deathlink settings. * Commands now work in console with the . prefix: `.ap`, `.ap_tracker`, `.ap_warp`, etc.
## Bug Fixes/Improvements * Fixed the completion checks on Blue Shift and OpFor being wonky. * Chargesanity being off would still display text on the user's screen when interacting with a charger. * Held weapons no longer send weapon checks if held on the map corresponding to their location. * Fixed a bug where finishing a mission and having the next mission unlocked would send an extra check that's not meant to be sent until that mission is actually loaded into. * Fixed a bug where chargesanity being disabled would also block weapon checks from being sent. * Made receiving ammo for the weapons you receive less annoying. * Some refinement of what and how information is displayed by commands. * Disconnecting and reconnecting or changing slots is now handled much more cleanly. * Game now syncs completion both ways, so collected checks propogate back to the game now. * Traps now queue up and trigger only after a 5 second gap of stability (not loading or dead). * New logic gating on the Barnacle Grapple for reaching Part 4 of Pit Worm's Nest and through the rest of the campaign. * Removed unreachable chargers on Pit Worm's Nest * Fixed an issue with mission completion for Duty Calls and Power Struggle
## Setup As the game host: Install the apworld by downloading and double clicking (or placing it in your custom_worlds folder) Open the Half-Life (Sven Co-op) Client and select your install directory Run /install in the client Connect the client to the multiworld, and open a server on the map -sp_campaign_lobby Once your friends are in game with you (they can just join!), you can type !ap to see unlocked missions in the console, and !warp to change maps to the unlocked mission. (The in-game panels also work)
## Known Issues * Sound cacheing bug: sometimes when another player joins the lobby, their sounds are all mixed up. This will self resolve once you get into a mission. I am under the impression that if they install the plugin too that helps, but I'm unsure. This one is kind of complicated to diagnose.

entry.content:
Another week another big update. Can you believe it, only 33 of the 862 locations are not fully mapped? The progress is insane and I want to express my gratitude to all who've been with this project whether it's just playing, reporting bugs or otherwise giving input on the matter. And ultra big shoutout to the mappers (who are all credited in the README), they've been doing an insane part in all this. I can safely say that logic will be extremely solid by the time 0.5.0 rolls out but also that I got something huge planned for it. (Also as usual if you like what I do and wanna [buy me a coffee](https://streamlabs.com/batatvideogames/tip) I'd appreciate it 👍)
# Changelog
### General updates:
- **Updated traversal, combat and wish logic in 244 existing rooms across 29 areas** - Added combat requirements to 77 mapped bosses/gauntlets - Shops and wishes now display matching Silksong item icons - Pressing A on needle in inventory allows to toggle between the upgrades unlocked so far - Made courier deliveries unbreakable but they instead need to logically satisfy being able to pick up the quest and getting to their delivery spot - Universal Tracker now supports newly generated seeds without a player YAML, automatically loading their settings and entrance layout - Reduced connection data size (by a lot) - Kept Skarr’s unchecked randomized shop items available after his story death
### Option updates
- Removed the bs "skips" option and instead separated it into proper categories (red tool stall, crest pogo skips, needle strike logic, heal stall logic, hazard respawn logic). The attached YAML and the built in AP Options Creator describe what these entail - Changed Proficient Combat from true (bypass combat reqs) and false (keep combat reqs) to off, goated (lower combat reqs by 1 tier) and hell (bypass combat reqs) - Silk and Soul Points now caps at 23. Higher numbers automatically clamp to 23 - Added optional trap disguises with mirrored shop/wish icons and subtly misspelled shop/crest names - Added independent Quill and Compass randomization settings. Kept Automatic Compass and Start Fully Mapped as separate conveniences
### Fixes:
- Fixed the randomized Egg of Flealia not being recognized when unlocking Flea Games and Ecstasy of the End - Fixed Peak_04d, Shellwood_13, Shellwood_25 and Crawl_09 screen being black when entering from "wrong" side when breakable walls are still present - Fixed Flick becoming non-interactable at Bone Bottoms wish wall, blocking courier turn-ins - Fixed Memorium - Shard Bundle incorrectly appearing in Act 1 goals - Threefold Pin now randomizes in Act 1 goals when tool randomization is enabled - Final Audience wish name correction (accidentally named it Last Audience) - Fixed the long pause when completing free randomized donations - Eva became inactive when Sylphsong gets sent (via other game release). Fixed that and also chapel doors remain open now - Fixed incorrect access to lower Whispering Vaults through the rotating-tunnel route - Fixed a Skill Shuffle starting layout that could prevent generation - General game generation updates (genuinely) - Corrected The Slab Memory Locket’s map marker position - Renamed "Progressive Compass" back to Quill - Fixed swapped entrance connections in the Sacred Cylinder room - Fixed Universal Tracker disconnecting when Silk & Soul points are set to random - Fixed swapped access logic for Memorium - Map Purchase and Memorium - Shard Bundle - Moved Putrified Ducts Shell Shard Cache 6 out of the ceiling to floor level - Grouped Blasted Steps Shell Shard Caches 4–5 with the Beast Shard marker - Fixed Sacred Cylinder moving randomized melody markers back to their vanilla position - Improved AP check visibility over other map pins - Fixed the Deep Docks lower climb’s movement requirements - Fixed shop stock getting stuck displaying generic “AP Item” text until reconnecting - Prevented Chapel Maid from appearing during an unfinished Moss Mother fight (lmao) - Fixed off-screen objective bubbles following vanilla locations instead of randomized bells and melodies - Corrected access logic for the Whispering Vaults map and Pale Oil, Whiteward Spool Fragment and Cogwork Core map - Fixed early Rune Rage receipt preventing First Sinner activation - Fixed Hunter's March big shaft room only needing ledgegrab to get to the treasure room with the Blowjob Brothers - Fixed Curvesickle being rejected by the Mottled Child’s throwing challenge (this time for real)

entry.title: New Super Mario Bros. DS v0.5.1
entry.content:
This update focuses heavily on **performance, stability, and bug fixes**. A lot of work went into reducing emulator stutters and improving the Lua runtime, HUD rendering, Traps, and client communication.
It also adds **Music Randomization**, **Death Link Amnesty**, and a new **Star Coin Tracking** option.
## Added
- Added **Music Randomization** with four modes: - Off - Level music - Level + World Map music - Mixed Level + World Map music - Added **Death Link Amnesty** - Controls how many local deaths are required before sending a Death Link - For example, a value of 5 sends every fifth eligible local death - Added a **Star Coin Tracking** option: - Instant collection - Vanilla behavior, where Star Coins are only saved after completing the level - Added new troubleshooting commands: - /nsmbds_diag [short|full] displays client, BizHawk, synchronization, and runtime information - /nsmbds_debug [on|off] enables or disables detailed NSMBDS debug logging
## Performance & Compatibility
- Significantly improved **runtime performance** - Reduced stuttering when sending and receiving items - Improved notification, Trap status, and protection HUD rendering - Improved performance of several Traps, especially **Pixelation** - Reduced unnecessary Lua and client processing - Improved **melonDS JIT compatibility** - Red Coin Challenges now work with JIT enabled - Several Trap and input systems now use native ROM hooks - Improved **Universal Tracker compatibility** - Improved **Ionium compatibility** - High randomized percentage values are now safely capped instead of causing generation failures - Empty filler selections are now supported
> **JIT Recompiler is recommended for better performance.**
## Logic & Fixes
- Fixed Red Coin Challenges not triggering with melonDS JIT enabled - Fixed several Star Coin Gate logic issues - Fixed incorrect Star Coin Gate ordering in some worlds - Fixed chained Star Coin Gates not accounting for earlier required gates - Fixed some collected Star Coins not counting correctly toward gate requirements - Fixed World 3-Tower Star Coin 3 missing its Mushroom Permit requirement - Fixed several BizHawk launcher and saved path issues - Improved handling of temporary client/BizHawk communication problems - Reduced unnecessary logging and repeated warnings - Various smaller runtime and stability fixes
## Important
A **newly generated 0.5.1 patch is recommended** because several native ROM hooks have changed.
## Links
- **Game Info:** https://github.com/Lemix028/Archipelago-NewSuperMarioBrosDS/tree/nsmbds/worlds/nsmbds/docs/en_New%20Super%20Mario%20Bros.%20DS - **Setup Guide:** https://github.com/Lemix028/Archipelago-NewSuperMarioBrosDS/tree/nsmbds/worlds/nsmbds/docs/setup_en.md - **PopTracker:** https://github.com/Lemix028/NewSuperMarioBrosDS-poptracker/releases/latest

entry.title: Taskipelago v1.2.0
entry.content:
*The big region overhaul (and also clicker game mode)*
## What's new * New types of item grouping definitions. Now progressive, aesthetic, or random-choice * aesthetic groups merely group things aesthetically with no effect on progression or not. * random-choice groups randomly choose N or N% as you define items from within the group to be included in the world. No tasks may depend on individual items in these groups since they aren't guaranteed to exist, but depending on the randomized group as a whole or by percentage/count is supported. * progressive groups function the same as always * Regions can now also be randomized to include N or N% of tasks within that region. May optionally also shuffle the order in which such tasks appear. * Subregions can now be defined within regions that aren't randomized (subregions may be randomized). * Regions may now depend on items and tasks via the syntax item(expr) and task(expr) where expr is any valid task or item dependency expression * Tasclickpelago toggle on the yaml generator that enables a bunch of features for building out an idle game because the concept was funny and I thought of a way to do it well. * Style tab added to the YAML generator so you can recolor the entire application at will while connected to the slot in question. Pretty colors are pretty. * Added syntax `item(...) and task(...)` to reference an item or task from within task prereqs and item prereqs fields respectively. This also works in the goal requirements, so you can now depend on receiving items to goal. The other benefit here is using OR operators on tasks and items together allowing for some interesting new logic. * Added a setting for filler items to grant a hint/scout for a random item (See the hint/scout dropdown). * Fix browser choice to use user's default where possible and never prefer Edge otherwise * Fix OR not working properly with region dependencies
Note: should be fully backwards compatible with worlds generated from 1.0 onwards. Also Universal Tracker is still incompatible.

entry.title: Crab Champions v1.4.0
entry.content:
## Highlights
Every weapon, melee weapon and ability can now go in the pool, only pool equipment counts toward your goal, and received perks and mods are applied as whole stacks.
**Compatible with 1.3 seeds.** Update the apworld and the mod together.
## Changes
### Full equipment pools `weapons_in_pool`, `melee_in_pool` and `abilities_in_pool` now go up to 20, 5 and 7, which puts every item of that kind in the pool. When a pool is full you start with one random item from it, so you always have something to use. `starting_weapons` is forced to at least 1 when `weapons_in_pool` is 20.
### Completion only counts pool equipment Equipment you have from the start no longer counts toward `weapons_for_completion`, `melee_for_completion` or `ability_for_completion`. With `equipment_check_mode` set to `regular` or `filler_only`, the goal could previously be finished without receiving a single AP item. Runs with non-pool equipment are still location checks under `equipment_check_mode`, they just don't advance the goal.
Seeds made with 1.3 keep the old rule, so updating mid-seed won't change your goal.
### Starting equipment isn't duplicated Equipment you start with is no longer also placed in the item pool. That slot goes to filler instead of a second copy of something you already have.
### `guaranteed_items` copy counts Counts are now honored for perks and mods, so `Time Bolt: 2` gives two copies. Relics and equipment are unique and still get one.
## Bug Fixes
- Received perks and mods are now applied as one stack per item. Duplicates that arrived after your inventory filled up no longer get stuck behind other items, and items you already have still stack when the inventory is full. - Fixed reconnecting mid-session leaving stale state behind, which could grant pending crystals twice or stop overflowed items from retrying. - The mod now refuses to connect to a seed made for a different major version instead of sending checks for the wrong locations, and the overlay says why.
## For Developers
- F9 writes a full pickup dump (`pickup_dump_<time>.txt`) with every item's rarity, loot pool and tag, and flags new and greed items. - `tools/check_sync.py` checks the Lua client's item tables against the apworld.
## Download
- Archipelago world: `crabchampions.apworld` → place in your Archipelago `custom_worlds/` directory - In-game mod: `CrabChampionsAP.zip` → extract into your Crab Champions `Mods/` directory (UE4SS required)
